about.title: Ambition serving development.
about.paragraph1: FOUTSET AFRICA SARL stands as a leading institutional partner, dedicated to transforming infrastructure across the continent. Our strength lies in our ability to run complex projects with absolute technical rigor.
about.paragraph2: We combine the agility of a modern company with the standards of excellence demanded by major industrial and government clients. Every project is approached with a systemic vision, guaranteeing durability, safety and performance.

cta.title: Ready to transform your vision?
cta.subtitle: Our engineers and consultants are ready to help you analyze your structural and technological needs.

reseaux-telecom.heroSubtitle: Designing, deploying and securing the networks that bring the continent closer together.
reseaux-telecom.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa designs, installs and maintains complete telecommunications infrastructure: VSAT satellite links, mobile base stations, microwave links and enterprise networks. Our team is involved across the whole chain, from technical study to commissioning.
reseaux-telecom.introParagraph2: We support operators, institutions and businesses in deploying resilient connectivity solutions, including in the most remote areas where fiber and terrestrial networks fall short.
reseaux-telecom.domainsSubtitle: Complete technical solutions, from satellite links to site security.
reseaux-telecom.feature1Description: Installation of VSAT terminals in C, Ku and Ka bands for dedicated or shared internet connectivity, with throughput of up to 200 Mbps.
reseaux-telecom.feature2Description: Deployment of GSM/3G/4G LTE base stations and microwave systems, with RF optimization, drive testing and performance indicator monitoring.
reseaux-telecom.compactDescription: VoIP, LAN/WLAN and server infrastructure deployment for enterprise networks.
reseaux-telecom.darkDescription: Installation of alarm systems, lightning protection and video surveillance to secure your technical sites.
reseaux-telecom.closingParagraph: In a hyperconnected world, network infrastructure is no longer a cost center but the backbone of your growth. We design robust architectures capable of supporting your future ambitions.
reseaux-telecom.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your network project

energie.heroSubtitle: Reliable energy solutions for a continent on the move.
energie.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa designs and installs energy solutions suited to on-the-ground constraints: photovoltaic systems, hybrid solutions and backup power devices, ensuring continuity of service for industrial, telecom and institutional sites.
energie.introParagraph2: Our approach favors accurately sized installations, combining performance, durability and long-term control of operating costs.
energie.domainsSubtitle: From design to maintenance, a complete chain of energy solutions.
energie.feature1Description: Design and installation of solar PV systems for industrial, telecom and residential sites.
energie.feature2Description: Installation of backup solutions to ensure continuous power supply to your critical infrastructure.
energie.compactDescription: Preventive and corrective monitoring of installations for lasting performance.
energie.darkDescription: Energy audits and custom sizing tailored to your technical and budgetary constraints.
energie.closingTitle: Energy, the condition for any transformation.
energie.closingParagraph: No infrastructure runs without a reliable power supply. We design energy solutions built to last, in environments where continuity of service is non-negotiable.
energie.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your energy project

formation.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa trains technical teams in the installation, commissioning and maintenance of the systems it deploys: networks, telecom, solar energy and VSAT infrastructure. Our training combines theory with hands-on fieldwork.
formation.introParagraph2: Our goal: to transfer lasting expertise to local teams, ensuring the operational independence of our clients and partners over the long term.
formation.domainsSubtitle: Technical training paths, aligned with our areas of expertise.
formation.feature1Description: Installation, commissioning and maintenance of VSAT satellite systems.
formation.feature2Description: Installation and maintenance of photovoltaic systems and backup power.
formation.compactDescription: Commissioning and maintenance of networks and telecom infrastructure.
formation.darkDescription: On-site support and certification of local teams for lasting independence.
formation.closingTitle: Skills that remain, long after the project.
formation.closingParagraph: Training is investing in the longevity of infrastructure. Every intervention is also an opportunity to durably strengthen the technical capacity of our clients and partners.
formation.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your training project

prestation.heroSubtitle: Technical and human expertise serving your projects.
prestation.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa provides qualified technicians and engineers to strengthen your teams on the ground, along with technical consulting support for your energy and telecom infrastructure projects.
prestation.introParagraph2: From feasibility study to final acceptance, we run every intervention with a rigorous methodology, guaranteeing adherence to deadlines and safety standards.
prestation.domainsSubtitle: Technical and human support, at every stage of your projects.
prestation.feature1Description: Engineering support and general consulting on your energy and ICT infrastructure.
prestation.feature2Description: Provision of specialized technicians and engineers to strengthen your teams.
prestation.compactDescription: Integrated management of your projects, from study to commissioning.
prestation.darkDescription: Project management methods guaranteeing adherence to deadlines and international safety standards.
prestation.closingTitle: Your project, our rigor of execution.
prestation.closingParagraph: Every engagement is run with the same standard: proven methodologies, a qualified team and a commitment to deadlines.
prestation.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your staffing needs

import-export.heroSubtitle: The right technical equipment, in the right place, at the right time.
import-export.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa manages the supply and logistics of the technical equipment needed for your energy and telecommunications projects: network hardware, VSAT systems, solar equipment and security infrastructure.
import-export.introParagraph2: We rely on a network of qualified international suppliers to guarantee the availability, compliance and traceability of the equipment delivered to your sites.
import-export.domainsSubtitle: From equipment selection to on-site delivery.
import-export.feature1Description: Supply of telecom, energy and ICT equipment, selected according to your specifications.
import-export.feature2Description: Import, export and delivery of technical equipment to your sites, including the most remote areas.
import-export.compactDescription: Compliance verification of equipment before on-site delivery.
import-export.darkDescription: A network of qualified international suppliers to guarantee availability and traceability.
import-export.closingTitle: The right part, at the right time, on the ground.
import-export.closingParagraph: A well-executed project also depends on a reliable supply chain. We secure the availability of your technical equipment, from supplier to site.
import-export.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your supply needs
